name: gemini-live-screen-windows
description: A lightweight, zero-latency Chrome Extension & local viewer that streams your live Windows desktop into a dedicated browser tab for Gemini Live, AI agents, and real-time screen sharing. Features zero recording, hardware acceleration, background active keep-alive, and full keyboard shortcuts with a modern dark Bento UI.
